title: Communicable disease control in China: From Mao to now
version: Rural cooperative care and worker numbers
lineage: Notes paraphrase selected source passages; not a source copy.

passages.locator: Rural cooperative care and worker numbers
passages.note: This review describes basic village care and health education and reports approximately one million barefoot doctors in 1970 and 1.8 million in 1977. The estimates concern worker headcount, not patients served or universal coverage.
